subject: Everything IT — competitor review (it.ie) + a few website ideas
body:
Dear Faraz,

As part of the ongoing work on the site, our CEO asked us to take a proper
look at one of your competitors — it.ie — and put together some ideas for
Everything IT's website off the back of it. We've also added a few ideas
of our own that didn't come from that review at all. Nothing here is built
or live — we wanted your read on it first.

WHAT STOOD OUT ON IT.IE

- Dedicated industry/sector pages (schools, healthcare, financial
services, logistics, etc.) alongside their location pages, so a visitor
can self-identify by industry, not just by city.

- A trust bar of certifications shown on nearly every page — ISO 27001,
Microsoft Gold Partner, Cyber Essentials, Guaranteed Irish — rather than a
single callout.

- 15+ named technology partners (SonicWall, Fortinet, Veeam, Microsoft,
and others) shown as a logo wall for credibility.

- Cybersecurity packaged into two named, sellable bundles rather than one
flat services page.

- A resources/blog hub — practical guides, checklists, and an annual
threat report.

- A dedicated Microsoft 365 page (including Copilot), rather than folding
it under Cloud Computing.

- 20+ named client testimonials shown at volume across the site.

A FEW IDEAS OF OUR OWN, SEPARATE FROM THE COMPETITOR REVIEW

- A free "Cyber Risk Assessment" tool on the site — the same lead-gen
mechanic as the Free SEO Check tool we run on our own site, adapted for
IT/security, and it can ask company size up front so it works with the new
15+ employee policy rather than against it.

- A short "switching IT providers" landing page aimed at businesses
unhappy with their current MSP — strong search intent, and quick to build
off the existing service-page template.

- A team/leadership bios page — puts faces to the business, which matters
in a relationship-led sector like managed IT.
